The 32GB Ultra USB 3.0 Flash DrivefromSanDiskmakes it simple to take all of your files with you on the go. This flash drive features a large storage capacity capable of holding a variety of files including movies, videos, photos, music, documents and more. With USB 2.0 and 3.0 compatibility you can plug this flash drive into nearly any PC or Mac and transfer your data to and from the drive at data speeds up to 100MB/s. This flash drive also comes equipped with 128-bit encryption ensuring the saved data remains secure.
